pair_interpretation: Incident wrong-pair share counts positive-negative ranking pairs touching at least one output in a slice. Compare with incident available-pair share. Slices overlap; shares do not sum to 100%. Increasing error share/enrichment can reflect improvements elsewhere rather than worsening absolute performance.

findings: The selected candidate improves pooled AUC in both years and reduces pooled misordered pairs by about 5.5% in 2021 and 4.9% in 2022 relative to the original winner. This is a historical improvement; the evidence does not support saying that generalization fails everywhere.

Remaining difficulty is concentrated around ON/OFF transitions: only 8.05%/11.87% of outputs in 2021/2022, yet 50.78%/67.80% of remaining wrong pairs involve them. Available-pair shares are 15.52%/24.51%, giving 3.27x/2.77x enrichment. Transition AUC improves but remains 0.8671/0.8724 versus 0.9935/0.9950 away from transitions.

Lio remains unstable across years: AUC improves +0.006697 in 2021 but declines -0.003267 in 2022. Both depth8 alone and the weighted neural mean alone reduce Lio 2022 AUC. Its ON fraction is similar across years (about 54.5%/55.0%), so prevalence change alone does not explain this instability.

Haukeli improves +0.000439/+0.010496 in 2021/2022, but remains one of the weakest generators (0.9638/0.9581). Hogga improves both years to 0.9705/0.9789. These plants still have more incident errors than pair availability alone would predict.

Within-month AUC improves 12/12 months in 2021 and 11/12 in 2022; March 2022 is the sole small decline (-0.000055). The hardest calendar periods differ by year, so a single fixed bad-season explanation is insufficient.

Depth8 does not independently confirm as a 2022 improvement: holding the selected weighted-neural and Haukeli means fixed, its marginal 2022 effect is -0.00012434. The full selected recipe still improves because other component changes compensate. The no-depth8 ablation is attribution, not a newly selected 2022 recipe.

The transition-loss emphasis control was subsequently tested on 2021 and did not beat the selected weighted-neural threshold (0.98853443 versus 0.98864894). Error concentration identifies a difficulty; it does not imply that simple extra loss weight solves it. RDrop, RankNet and row/column sampling also missed their prespecified advancement criteria.

next_steps_after_this_run.action: Evaluate the frozen recipe on a prespecified temporal split not already used to choose it, if one is available; keep further reused historical folds explicitly developmental.

next_steps_after_this_run.action: For Lio, inspect ON-start and OFF-stop timing errors separately from confidence errors during stable states before choosing another model change.
next_steps_after_this_run.reason: This candidate improves other difficult plants but has a reproducible 2022 Lio regression; whole-model tuning would obscure that local failure.

limitations: 2021 and 2022 are heavily reused development years, and checkpoint selection used 2021.
The proposed combined recipe is frozen; this report does not alter selection based on 2022 component ablations.
Subgroup AUC is not an additive decomposition of pooled micro AUC; incident pair shares overlap.
Conditional bootstrap shows stronger evidence versus the original winner than versus the already improved fallback.
This report contains no competition test labels and cannot establish the future public or private leaderboard score.
